The problem statement uses 1-based indexing in its description (i = 1..N, j = N+1-i, cell (i,i) to (j,j)), but the output instructions say “the i-th line should contain … the i-th row” without explicitly confirming whether i starts at 1 or 0.  

If we misinterpret indexing (e.g., use 0-based internally while the algorithm is 1-based), the whole pattern will be shifted incorrectly. That’s a fundamental implementation issue.  

The most important ambiguity is therefore about the indexing convention for rows and columns in the algorithm versus output.  

Question 1 directly asks whether rows and columns are indexed from 1 (as implied) or from 0, which is the core ambiguity that would change how we implement the loops and cell references.  

ANSWER: 1
